Title: Kunal and the Family

Cast

1. Kunal - 12 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Meera - 9 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
3. Pallavi - 34 years, mother
Look: green saree
4. Aditya - 12 years, friend
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
5. Sharda - 71 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Kunal stands in the living room. Meera, Pallavi and Aditya stand near him.]

Meera: "Today feels like a good day."

[Kunal combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Kunal: "That's great!"

[Meera applies kajal to her eyes.]

Meera (laughing): "Yes, all right."

[Kunal takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Kunal (gently): "Meera, are you okay?"

[Kunal drinks a glass of water.]

Kunal: "And then?"

[Kunal mops the floor.]

Kunal: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Kunal flops down on the sofa.]

Kunal (excited): "How beautiful!"

[Kunal sits cross-legged on the floor.]

Meera: "I really enjoyed today."
